description: Variation of Condition 1 of planning permission dated 22 June 2023 (22/08028/FULL) for: partial demolition, alterations, extensions and refurbishment of existing buildings to provide a part 4-8 storey block plus one basement level for use as Hotel (Class C1) with ancillary facilities and roof terrace; continued pub/bar (Sui Generis) and residential (Class C3) at 23 Wellington Street; provision of plant, servicing, cycle parking and other associated works namely, the creation of eight additional hotel guest bedrooms, internal layout changes to the hotel and alterations to doors to the corner entrance on Wellington Street/Tavistock Street.
